title: Canada plans 'nuclear renaissance' with up to 10 reactors built by 2040
summary: Canada announced a federal nuclear strategy aiming to build up to 10 nuclear reactors by 2040, marking a significant shift in the country's energy policy to address climate goals and energy security.
problem_solved: Addresses Canada's need for clean baseload power generation to meet net-zero emissions targets and enhance energy independence.
why_valuable: Nuclear power provides reliable, low-carbon electricity that can complement intermittent renewables like solar and wind, helping Canada decarbonize its electricity grid while ensuring energy security.
